setup.name: backend-sync
argv:
import os, pathlib, subprocess, sys
root = pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve()
def confined(path):
    path = pathlib.Path(path)
    if not path.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
        sys.exit('Selected path escapes worktree: ' + str(path))
    return path
def run(args, cwd):
    subprocess.run(args, cwd=cwd, check=True)
import configparser, tomllib
project = None
for candidate in (root, root / 'backend'):
    if any(confined(candidate / name).is_file() for name in ('pyproject.toml', 'requirements.txt')):
        project = confined(candidate)
        break
if project is None:
    sys.exit('Missing Python manifest: pyproject.toml or requirements.txt')
manifest = confined(project / 'pyproject.toml')
lock = confined(project / 'uv.lock')
requirements = confined(project / 'requirements.txt')
venv = confined(project / '.venv')
confined(venv / 'bin')
cache = confined(project / '.cache')
confined(cache / 'uv')
confined(cache / 'pip')
python = str(venv / 'bin' / 'python')
config = tomllib.loads(manifest.read_text()) if manifest.is_file() else {}
if manifest.is_file() and lock.is_file():
    run(['uv', 'sync', '--locked', '--all-groups', '--no-python-downloads', '--cache-dir', str(cache / 'uv')], project)
else:
    if not venv.exists():
        run([sys.executable, '-m', 'venv', str(venv)], project)
    args = ['-r', str(requirements)] if requirements.is_file() else ['.']
    run([python, '-m', 'pip', 'install', '--cache-dir', str(cache / 'pip')] + args, project)

    path = pathlib.Path(path)
    if not path.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
        sys.exit('Selected path escapes worktree: ' + str(path))

def run(args, cwd):
    subprocess.run(args, cwd=cwd, check=True)
import configparser, tomllib
project = None
for candidate in (root, root / 'backend'):
    if any(confined(candidate / name).is_file() for name in ('pyproject.toml', 'requirements.txt')):
        project = confined(candidate)
        break
if project is None:
    sys.exit('Missing Python manifest: pyproject.toml or requirements.txt')

lock = confined(project / 'uv.lock')
requirements = confined(project / 'requirements.txt')
venv = confined(project / '.venv')

cache = confined(project / '.cache')
confined(cache / 'uv')

enabled = 'mypy' in config.get('tool', {}) or ini.has_section('mypy')
if enabled:
    run([python, '-m'] + ['mypy', '.'], project)
